cards.name: Ecstatic Awakener // Awoken Demon
cards.oracleText: {2}{B}, Sacrifice another creature: Draw a card, then transform this creature. Activate only once each turn.

cards.name: Thing in the Ice // Awoken Horror
cards.oracleText:
Defender
This creature enters with four ice counters on it.
Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, remove an ice counter from this creature. Then if it has no ice counters on it, transform it.
When this creature transforms into Awoken Horror, return all non-Horror creatures to their owners' hands.

cards.name: Awoken Nephilim
cards.oracleText: During deck construction, name a Nephilim card originally printed in Guildpact. Awoken Nephilim has that card's color identity and is a copy of that card in all zones except it's also Legendary.
